scope: Actual independent synthetic dataset, prespecified profile; no causal claim

effective_configuration.prior_source: Explicit Normal/Laplace baseline priors with declared scale multiplier; native media/likelihood defaults

operational.scope: Immutable dataset lineage and successful solver/native restoration only

mcmc.scope: Rank R-hat, bulk/tail ESS and divergences only; inspect mixing, PPC, priors and identification separately. Sample-count screens are operational, not universal guarantees.

statistical.scope: Screened numerical and sensitivity diagnostics; model correctness is not guaranteed

limitations: Imported assignments and review declarations do not authenticate randomization or execution
Compatible placebos and negative controls do not prove exchangeability
No automatic causal claim, extrapolation across populations or budget action
Geographic experiments require independent geo units; repeated days are not independent geos
Multiplicity across separate experiments and transportability require a prespecified design review

diagnostics.method: ArviZ rank-normalized split R-hat, bulk ESS and tail ESS

scientific_diagnostics.trace_scope: Up to 128 actual unrounded draw positions per chain, at most 64 scalar parameters; visual review remains a human task
scientific_diagnostics.method: Native ArviZ rank-normalized split R-hat, bulk/tail ESS, MCSE; full posterior

posterior_predictive_check.interpretation: Descriptive holdout posterior predictive checks; time points are dependent, tail probabilities are not frequentist p-values; no automatic model approval

warnings: No automatic causal or investment certification; missing evidence remains inconclusive
